title: Elite Dangerous Third-Party Tools: Alternatives to EDDiscovery, EDMC, EDOMH & Observatory | Elite Nexus
description: Which Elite Dangerous third-party tools do what, and where Elite Nexus fits: an all-in-one alternative to EDDiscovery, ED Market Connector, Odyssey Materials Helper, Observatory, EDHM and more, including what each still does better.
heading: One app for the tools you run side by side.
lead: Many commanders run four to eight third-party tools next to Elite Dangerous, plus a few websites. Here is what each popular tool does, which parts Elite Nexus covers in one native Windows app, and where the specialist tool is still the better choice.
hero_alt: Elite Nexus dashboard with commander ranks, ship status, location and session stats in one window
hero_caption: One window for the jobs that usually take several tools and browser tabs.
